name: OD-ORD-03 Take the day's orders from a sheet
covers: Order numbers go up by one, and each order's product, quantity, gift wrap, note and total are saved

checks.sql: select Number from Orders where Status = 'New'
checks.label: New orders

checks.sql: select Product from Orders where Number = 1002
select Quantity from Orders where Number = 1002
select Total from Orders where Number = 1003
checks.label: Mug, gift wrapped

checks.sql: select Number from Orders where GiftWrap = 1 order by Number
checks.label: Orders gift wrapped

checks.sql: select Total from Orders where Number = 1005
select Notes from Orders where Number = 1005

look: The list shows 1001 to 1005, oldest first.
